g.title: qa_workflow
g.text: QA run: a finished pull request is tried against the running application, and the report goes on the ticket

g.title: cluster_legend
g.text: Legend

g.title: cluster_loop
g.text: Test loop (3 attempts at most)

g.title: start
g.text: A person comments on the ticket or the pull request
/qa · /qa full · /qa api|ui · /qa <note>

g.title: find
g.text: Find the factory's open pull request
(branch factory/issue-<n>, same repository)
read .factory/project.json → verify

g.title: rules
g.text: open pull request of the factory?
the project has verify and the suite asked for?

g.title: refuse
g.text: ignored without a word (not the factory's)
or a short note: none · closed · no verify settings

g.title: rules->refuse
g.text: no

g.title: co
g.text: Check out the pull request's own branch

g.title: rules->co
g.text: yes

g.title: tester
g.text: e2e-tester
starts the app, tries it from the outside,
writes API / UI tests under the tests folder
scope: the change · or the whole app (full) · your note

g.title: only
g.text: only files under the tests folder changed?
no deletions · no secrets · no protected files

g.title: only->tester
g.text: no: sent back with the reason

g.title: run
g.text: THE FACTORY runs each suite itself
start the app · wait for verify.ready · run the suite · stop it
no model login · exit code decides

g.title: only->run
g.text: yes

g.title: pass
g.text: every suite passed?

g.title: infra
g.text: the sandbox failed for the factory's own reasons
infrastructure_failed · comment /qa again

g.title: run->infra
g.text: sandbox error

g.title: pass->tester
g.text: no: the output goes back; the tester says per test
application bug or test problem

g.title: ux
g.text: ux (UI suite only)
reads the page text and accessibility
snapshots the tests left as evidence

g.title: pass->ux
g.text: yes, or out of attempts
or the tester blames only the app

g.title: clean
g.text: Remove the evidence folder
and check nothing else was written

g.title: push
g.text: Push ONE commit with the tests
onto the pull request's branch

g.title: clean->push
g.text: all passed

g.title: save
g.text: Tests NOT added to the pull request
saved on a -wip branch for a person to look at

g.title: clean->save
g.text: otherwise

g.title: report
g.text: Report on the ticket
suite results · scenarios · where the tests went · UX review
numbered findings to fix · tokens used

g.title: person
g.text: A person reads the report
and decides (the factory never merges)

g.title: fix
g.text: /fix qa on the pull request
the revision flow addresses the numbered findings,
then /qa again

g.title: person->fix
g.text: findings

g.title: til1
g.text: agent (a role file in a sandbox)

g.title: til2
g.text: factory code decides or checks

g.title: til3
g.text: deterministic check the factory runs itself

g.title: til4
g.text: a person
